contract_name: Conceptual Physics Question Design Map Contract
purpose: Require plan-first question ecosystem design before prompt generation so I-can evidence, quantitative/formula work, vocabulary, representations, multi-step dependencies, and parallel variety are intentional rather than template-filled.
authority: Dedicated `_question_structure.zip` owns the universal taxonomy/schema; this contract supplies Physics-specific fit rules.

physics_rules.quantitative_priority: When an I-can naturally expects mathematical/formula application, plan enough real quantitative/formula evidence that students practice using the relationship; do not let generic conceptual/vocabulary items crowd it out.
physics_rules.formula_context: Physics formula questions begin from a coherent physical situation/phenomenon that naturally supplies measurements; naked variable-assignment prompts are not the default.
physics_rules.formula_directionality: Vary which quantity is unknown and which givens are supplied when the relationship permits it. Do not default to one solve direction.
physics_rules.multistep_dependency: Multi-step means an intermediate result is required for the final task. Prefer one natural final question when the intermediate is only a means to the final result; do not force artificial (a)/(b).
physics_rules.units: Keep units internally compatible unless conversion is explicitly part of the learning target.
physics_rules.representation_map: For each I-can, explicitly consider actual graph/table/FBD/vector/model/diagram use and the Framework grapher tool. Mark N/A with a target-based reason rather than using token visuals.
physics_rules.variety_no_quota: The I-can determines the mix. Not every I-can needs matching, vocabulary, graph, diagram, multi-step, or all wording profiles.
physics_rules.family_semantics: question_family_id names the semantic evidence family and must not use form/version/question-number tokens to manufacture uniqueness.

destination_rules.WTC: Preserve the normal Bank-card presentation. Author one FRQ-like shared stimulus with connected parts for decomposition/navigation practice. External workbook/released FRQs are morphology references only.
destination_rules.Example_YTI: When formula-capable, strong contextual quantitative Example/YTI pairs take priority over generic conceptual/vocabulary filler. Example models; YTI applies with meaningful changed evidence.
destination_rules.Practice: Plan an I-can-specific mix from formula/direct/inverse/multistep/vocabulary/matching/graph/diagram/short-answer/misconception/transfer as appropriate. Parallel families are expected; variety is intentional, not maximal.
destination_rules.Warm_Up: Preserve the established retrieval pattern; controlled repetition is desirable.
destination_rules.Exit_Ticket: Plan variety within each four-question ticket and across A/B/C. Exit destination is formative-secure for Physics semantic-independence QA regardless of a weaker metadata label.
destination_rules.Summative: Plan form-level evidence before prompts. Family IDs stay semantic across V1-V6. V1-V4 may be same-day parallel with independent stimuli; V5/V6 require genuinely different makeup/alternate evidence.
